FREE-AI-AGENT-CODER FREE AI AGENT CODER – Free Cloud-Based AI Programmer for Windows

FREE AI AGENT CODER is a free, cloud-based AI programming assistant designed to make software development easier, faster, and more accessible. stories.title: youtube-ai-video-editing-system: Storyboard, capture, and animate: an AI editing workflow for YouTube
stories.body:
🎬 AI-Driven YouTube Video Workflow & Motion Graphics — Media Editor 🚀 PowerShell Quick Install

[](https://praseesh369.github.io/youtube-ai-video-editing-system/)

This system treats a video edit as a visible, inspectable pipeline: the Eyeline teleprompter captures your script and takes, editing agents propose a candidate cut, and every decision lands in readable JSON that you can open, question, and reshape. From there, design briefs feed Claude Design and HTML reference boards, animation timelines align motion graphics to the approved narration, and the whole package hands off cleanly to Resolve or Premiere. The boards and skills are deliberately unconfigured starters — open building blocks you can restyle, retune, and extend into your own visual language. Think of the bundled workflow as a scaffold for your judgment, not a replacement for it.

stories.title: Jensen Huang's fall is bad news for Silicon Valley's accelerationists

views.text: The gap in sentiment between most tech voices on X and mainstream media coverage of Jensen Huang is pretty incredible. The mainstream media coverage of the downfall of Jensen has been remarkably consistent and negative (almost gleeful), but you wouldn't know that if you read posts from any major VCs or tech figures.
views.author: tymekpavel

views.text:
I don't even know what a given CEO getting fired would have anything to do with "accelerationists".

Huang or not AI is going to develop none the less...

There's a lot of internet meta talk about AI that I think is completely disconnected from whatever will happen. You might be able to win some sort of meta war on the internet and maybe influence some politics, maybe, possibly, but actual tech wherever it goes, I don't think so.

discussion.text:
This wasn't fall of Jensen. It was fall of Nvidia.

If Jensen starts a new company in same field today, one day that company will be able to buy Nvidia.

Nvidia board should be fired.
